Treat a team as a distinct `team_id` and year combination; calculate the same averages and counts for each team-season, even though the requested output shows only `team_id`.
Group records with a missing `team_id` together as one team and include that group if its average win rate is defined.

queries:
WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN g <> 0 THEN 1.0 * w / g END) AS average_win_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM team
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    average_win_rate,
    record_count,
    average_win_rate - (
        SELECT AVG(average_win_rate)
        FROM team_averages
    ) AS difference_from_mean
FROM team_averages;

SELECT
    team_id,
    AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(w + l, 0)) AS average_win_rate
FROM team
GROUP BY team_id
HAVING AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(w + l, 0)) IS NOT NULL
